about: Concrete transition graph and exact key interner mutants (MODEL-BASED-PATH-TESTS P1).

mutants.name: paths-fingerprint-is-identity
mutants.rule: KeyTable uses the hash only to locate a dense bucket; exact canonical wire-key byte equality decides identity even under hash collision.

mutants.name: paths-drop-visited-edge
mutants.rule: BuildConcrete records every attempted concrete edge before deduplicating its successor state, preserving cycles and joins.

mutants.name: paths-merge-ignore-reject
mutants.from:
case Reject:
				Continue[S, MachineObs[O]]{Next: s, Obs: MachineObs[O]{Kind: DisReject, Output: None}}
mutants.to:
case Reject:
				Continue[S, MachineObs[O]]{Next: s, Obs: MachineObs[O]{Kind: DisIgnore, Output: None}}
mutants.rule: ConcreteOf preserves Reject distinct from Ignore even though both keep the state unchanged.
